source.subject: PeoplePlanner roster export is slow on Sunday evenings
source.summary: Roster export takes several minutes on Sunday evenings when the weekly roster locks. Assess whether the export path can be triaged as a performance task without touching code.

instructions: Investigate, without modifying anything, why the roster export is slow on Sunday evenings: identify the likely code path, the queries or loops involved, and what evidence a follow-up code change job would need. Report findings only.
acceptance_criteria: The export code path is identified with file references at the exact base SHA.
The dominant cost is described with a plausible mechanism.
A follow-up draft-PR job is outlined with a bounded allowed-path set.
